newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania's biggest holding firm to give back money.
newsitem.headline: Albania's biggest holding firm to give back money.

text.p: Vefa Holding, Albania's biggest holding company which froze client accounts during a pyramid investment scandal last month, said on Wednesday it would pay back all deposits to small investors immediately.
Vefa, which has 240 businesses and 80,000 investors in Albania, said starting immediately it would make full repayment to investors who had put up to $5,000 in the company.

The company said the decision was taken by Vehbi Alimucaj, Vefa Holding president, and the initial phase of paying small investors, who make up 60 percent of Vefa's clients, would last two to three weeks.

Investors will get only their capital investment and none of the interest due, company representative Arben Iliazi told Reuters. Albania has been swept by protests and riots since January, when five fraudulent pyramid schemes collapsed.
Those failures put the spotlight on other investment firms, such as Vefa, which froze clients' accounts fearing there would be a run of panic withdrawals.
